QuestInfo.name: A Letter to the Empress
QuestInfo.0: According to #p1002104#, the letter is written in a secret code. Thankfully, #b#p1201000##k should be able to decode it, so take the letter over to #b#m140000000##k.
QuestInfo.1: According to #p1002104#, the letter is written in a secret code. Thankfully, #b#p1201000##k should be able to decode it, so take the letter over to #b#m140000000##k.
QuestInfo.2: Amazingly, the letter written by the heroes was addressed to the Empress of the time. The actual content of the letter simply asked that the Empress take good care of the Seal Stone of #m130000000#.

0.0: There's definitely something in this letter, but it's written in code. It looks pretty complicated... \r\nYou said a member of the Black Wings was reading it, right? Then that must mean #rthey know the contents of this letter#k. It may be in code, but they must have someone who can decode it.
0.1: #b#p1201000##k will be able to decode this. Take the letter to #p1201000#, and hurry!\r\n#b(When you accept, you will move immediately to Rien.)#k

no.0: Eh? This is quite urgent. What's going on? Are you planning on hanging out tonight with #p2131000#? She's busy, too, and I am not sure if she can afford to set aside some time to hang out with you.

npc.0: You still haven't gone to #b#m140000000##k? If you want to get there before the Black Wings, you'll need to hand the letter to #b#p1201000##k immediately!

item.0: Aran? Tru told me you ventured into the past for some valuable knowledge. Have you come back? Tru told me I won't be disappointed this time around...

lost.0: Ahhh, Aran, why did you drop something so valuable like this? You know very well how important this letter is! Good thing I got it back. Otherwise, what would have happened? Here, hold onto it tightly and head over to #m140000000#.
